question: Should an ink line's width vary along it, and how? (the design doc's still-to-build shared stroke routine with width variation and tapered ends)
source: reference/mockups/unit_sheet.html with its Pen line switch; seed 20261009; shadows 0.44; everything else at the sheet's defaults

options.name: A
options.about: today: one width along the whole stroke

options.name: B
options.about: hand pressure: width swells and thins along the stroke (noise of arc length, 0.62-1.37 x) and tapers over up to 7 px where the pen lands and lifts, including at every break

options.name: C
options.about: shadow side: a closed outline is 0.42 x on edges facing the sun and up to 1.87 x on edges facing away; open lines 0.85 x with tapered ends

options.name: D
options.about: broad nib held at 45 degrees: width 0.28-1.58 x by stroke direction, tapered ends
